_note: Terrain horizon for own coordinates (ADR 0106, revisits ADR 0037). scripts/terrain_coarse.py writes into data/terrain/ the full 80 m grid within 20 km of the pole (crop_px × crop_px around the pole; on the 400 m copy alone the two measured points there fail the gate, ADR 0106) and block-mean copies (factor) of the two LOLA south-polar grids of config/horizon.json (16-bit little-endian, height = DN * dn_scale_m above moon_radius_m, south pole at the grid centre). The page loads them only when an own point lies at or south of lat_max, once per page, and casts the same rays as scripts/horizon.py (ray settings from config/horizon.json) in a Web Worker. Finest grid first. scripts/terrain_gate.mjs measures the agreement with the 80 m profiles (data/horizon/) at every listed site that has one; gate_pct is the share of hours in which both answers (Sun up, Earth up) must agree.
_note_pole: The pole crop keeps the 80 m pixels unchanged (factor 1); its max_lat is the latitude at the middle of its edge, for reading only. Rays leave it and continue on the 400 m and 960 m copies.
_note_cache: Skylines kept in memory per page (most recent own points); older ones are computed again when chosen.
